info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Miles-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Miles Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about airline flights based on mileage criteria. This API allows travel agencies, airline partners, and developers to fetch flight data, which can be used for comparisons, pricing, and customer information services. Common use cases include integrating flight mile information into travel portals or mobile applications, enhancing customer experiences, and optimizing travel planning. By providing a straightforward access point to essential flight metrics, this API supports various travel-related functionalities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the total miles earned from their flights. It provides an overview of the mileage accumulation based on flight history and user preferences.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving flight miles must include necessary parameters in JSON format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the mileage data for flights.
